title: NASA GeneLab Data Processing Proteomics Pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow workflow for GL-DPPD-[LFQ-MBR], GL-DPPD-[TMT10], GL-DPPD-[TMT16], and GL-DPPD-[TMT16-phospho].

accession.description: OSD or GLDS accession. Used to pull the ISA archive when sheets are not supplied.

runsheet.description: LFQ runsheet. For OSDR, generated from the ISA archive when not supplied.

data_sheet.description: TMT data sheet. Required for TMT.

sample_sheet.description: TMT sample sheet. Required for TMT.

isa_archive.description: Path or URL to ISA.zip. If omitted, pulled from OSDR when the runsheet (LFQ) or data sheet and sample sheet (TMT) are missing.

entry_point.description: mzml starts from spectra. fragpipe_output starts from an existing FragPipe folder.

fragpipe_output.description: Unzipped fragpipe{assay_suffix}.zip or the FRAGPIPE module output/ folder. Required when entry_point is fragpipe_output.

fragpipe_workflow_config.description: Path to a custom FragPipe .workflow file.

fragpipe_tools.description: Headless FragPipe --config-tools-folder. MSFragger, IonQuant, and diaTracer JARs plus ext/bruker and ext/thermo.

tech_rep.description: first keeps one technical replicate for FragPipe. all searches every technical replicate.

require_bioreplicate.description: Require Bioreplicate on the LFQ runsheet or TMT sample sheet. false fills missing values in sheet order.

reference_table.description: GL-DPPD-7110-A annotations CSV. With the sheet organism, stages the pinned proteome and genelab_annots_link.

uniprot_id.description: UniProt proteome ID. Philosopher --id download. Mutually exclusive with reference_proteome.

reference_proteome.description: Pre-formed reference proteome FASTA. Mutually exclusive with uniprot_id.

gene_annotations_file.description: Direct gene-annotation table. Skips the reference_table genelab_annots_link lookup.

philosopher_reviewed.description: Swiss-Prot only for a UniProt download. Unset uses reviewed for Arabidopsis, human, and mouse.

philosopher_isoforms.description: Include isoforms on a UniProt download.

philosopher_enzyme.description: Digestion enzyme for the UniProt download.

philosopher_spike_in.description: Spike-in FASTA added to the database.

philosopher_contaminants_prefix.description: Philosopher --contamprefix. Empty leaves new cRAP sequences untagged.

drop_decoys_contams.description: Drop rev_ and contam_ rows before MSstats and FragPipeAnalystR.

fp_analyst_keep_contaminants.description: FragPipeAnalystR reads unfiltered quantification tables. MSstats still uses the filtered table.

fp_analyst_levels.description: Comma-separated levels: protein, peptide, gene, site. Unset uses protein,peptide for LFQ and protein,gene,peptide,site for TMT.

fp_analyst_min_global_appearance.description: Minimum percent present across all samples. 0 disables the filter.

fp_analyst_min_appearance_one_cond.description: Minimum percent present in at least one condition.

fp_analyst_protein_feature_list.description: Comma-separated protein IDs for feature plots. Empty uses top_n_protein.

fp_analyst_gene_feature_list.description: Comma-separated gene names for feature plots. Empty uses top_n_gene.

fp_analyst_peptide_feature_list.description: Comma-separated peptide IDs for feature plots. Empty uses top_n_peptide.

fp_analyst_site_feature_list.description: Comma-separated site IDs for feature plots. Empty uses top_n_site.

fp_analyst_top_n_protein.description: Top N variable proteins when the protein feature list is empty. 0 skips.

fp_analyst_top_n_gene.description: Top N variable genes when the gene feature list is empty. 0 skips.

fp_analyst_top_n_peptide.description: Top N variable peptides when the peptide feature list is empty. 0 skips.

fp_analyst_top_n_site.description: Top N variable sites when the site feature list is empty. 0 skips.

fp_analyst_qc_plot_data.description: Matrix used for PCA, correlation, feature, and CV plots.

fp_analyst_sample_cvs_full_range.description: Sample CV axis. true is the full range. false is 0-1.

fp_analyst_volcano_display_names.description: Label significant points on the volcano plot.

fp_analyst_volcano_show_gene.description: Volcano labels use gene names. false uses the protein or peptide ID.

fp_analyst_zip.description: Write the QC, comparison, pathway, and DE plot zip files.

fp_analyst_enrichment_database.description: Comma-separated Enrichr databases. Empty skips over-representation.

fp_analyst_gsea_database.description: Comma-separated GSEA databases. Protein, gene, and site only. Empty skips GSEA.

clean_paths.description: Scrub paths from published artifacts during post-processing.

skip_vv.description: Skip VV_STEP and VV_CONCAT_FILTER. VALIDATE_PROCESSING still runs.

results_dir.description: Results directory name. Unset uses results, or the GLDS accession when accession is set.

pbs_internet_queue.description: PBS queue for fetch and download processes. Empty uses pbs_queue.

walltime.description: Default process.time on slurm and pbspro. Ignored on local.

version.description: Print the workflow version and exit.

help.description: Print the parameter help and exit.

trace_timestamp.description: Timestamp used in Nextflow report filenames.
